    c.entity_key AS studio_id,
    c.company_name AS studio_name,
    COUNT(co.content_key) AS entry_count
FROM core co
JOIN companies c ON co.studiolink = c.entity_key
GROUP BY c.entity_key, c.company_name
ORDER BY entry_count DESC;
